name: Meeting Saathi (Personal)
description: Records your Google Meet calls and sends them to your local Meeting Saathi for automatic MOM/Meeting Analysis generation.
_comment_key: SaaS conversion Phase 4: pins this extension's ID to a fixed value (see EXTENSION_ID in app/site_routes.py's install page) so the website's /account/connect page always knows which extension ID to chrome.runtime.sendMessage() to pair a device token -- without this, every 'Load unpacked' install would get a random, different id, and the website could never know which one to message for a given customer. This is the public half of a keypair generated once for this purpose; the private half was discarded (never needed again -- this is a stable-id anchor for an unpacked/sideloaded install, not a signed .crx).
_comment_externally_connectable: Real production domain (meetingsaathi.apriltech.org) plus localhost:8420, kept for local development/testing of the pairing flow only -- no placeholder, tunnel, or hosting-provider wildcard host permissions left in a production build.

start-recording.description: Start recording the current Google Meet call
